<b>Beast Shards</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Can be used from the inventory to gain {{S|140}}.


== How to Acquire ==
There are a total of nine Beast Shards in the game, which can be found after defeating specific [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]], picked up from [[Items (Silksong)|glowing item spots]], and received as a [[Wish]] reward.

{| class="article-table" width="100%" 
! 
! Location
! Map
|-
! colspan=3 | Enemy drops
|-
! 1
| In [[Act 1]] or [[Act 2]], dropped by a [[Marrowmaw]] in the hidden room to the right of the starting area in [[Moss Grotto]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Marrowmaw 01.png|center|200px]]
|-
! 2
| Dropped by [[Craggler]] in the [[Wormways]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Craggler 01.png|center|200px]]
|-
! 3
| In [[Act 1]] or [[Act 2]], dropped by [[Rhinogrund]] in [[Pilgrim's Rest]].
Requires [[Cling Grip]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Rhinogrund 01.png|center|200px]]
|-
! 4
| Dropped by [[Rhinogrund]] in the [[Memorium]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Rhinogrund 03.png|center|200px]]
|-
! 5
| In [[Act 3]], if not defeated prior, dropped by [[Skull Tyrant]] in [[the Marrow]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Skull Tyrant 01.png|center|200px]]
|-
! 6
| In [[Act 2]] or [[Act 3]], if not defeated prior, dropped by [[Moorwing]] in [[Greymoor]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Moorwing 02.png|center|200px]]
|-

|-

| Found after destroying a shard statue behind a breakable wall in [[Blasted Steps]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Beast Shard 02.png|center|200px]]
|-

| Found in the lower area of [[Deep Docks]] on the way to the [[Diving Bell]].
Requires [[Clawline]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Beast Shard 01.png|center|200px]]
|-

|-
